name: Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker
desc:
Solitary Seclusion: Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker

A priestess of the Masters of the Night-Wind who has lived apart from her tribe, honing her abilities in utter solitude. It is said that her Spiritspeaking powers surpass those of ordinary priests and shamans, a result of having had the protection of the Masters of the Night-Wind's Wayob bestowed upon her.

value.name: Flow of Forms
value.desc:
Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker: Flow of Forms

"Night and day, in a place of exile far from worldly clamor, a hermit contemplates an ever-changing flow of forms and the metaphors they contain. Any warrior with the courage to step up and accept her challenge will face the colorful trials she has woven."

value.text: Reward for accepting the Tavern Challenge at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with the Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker

value.name: Wayward Hermetic Spiritspeaker
value.desc: A priestess of the Masters of the Night-Wind who has lived apart from her tribe, honing her abilities in utter solitude. It is said that her Spiritspeaking powers surpass those of ordinary priests and shamans, a result of having had the protection of the Masters of the Night-Wind's Wayob bestowed upon her. Both a blessing and a curse, these powers were at first beyond her ability to control, which was why she set out to master them in isolation from her tribe. Though she has since done so, to this day she still lives in seclusion, a habit that has earned her a reputation as a loner and a recluse. Rumor has it, however, that she is more than willing to teach those who seek her guidance — though always on her own terms...

desc.text:
<color=#ffd680>Elemental Skill</color>
Deals 1 <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> , places 1 <color=#ffffff>Radiant Hues</color> third from the top of your deck, and <color=#ffffff>Select</color> 1 of 3 random <color=#ffffff>Radiant Hues</color> enhancement effects.

<color=#ffd680>Elemental Burst</color>
Deals 4 <color=#99ffff>Cryo DMG</color> , and adds 1 <color=#ffffff>Radiant Hues</color> to your Hand.

<color=#ffd680>Passive Skill</color>
(Passive) When battle begins, create 3 <color=#ffffff>Radiant Hues</color> and place them evenly into your deck.

Applies Cryo and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Melt</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> : DMG+1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>]</color> <color=#ffffff>Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives Physical or Pyro DMG, in which case they will take +2 DMG)

<color=#ebe4d8>Combat Action</color>
After you finish 1 Combat Action, it will be your opponent's turn.
<color=#ffffff>Playing a card from your Hand with this rule is also a Combat Action rather than a Fast Action</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Select</color>
Select 1 card from a specific number of cards and activate its effects.

customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
